performance_question: At 16 clients and a 512-outstanding-request cap per client, can one Envoy callout gateway faithfully complete the frozen Mooncake trace at approximately 8,071 offered RPS?
quality_gates: All clients complete, zero errors/cancellations, every cache HIT, zero degraded replay, max p99 schedule lag 500 ms, profiling-start spread <=3 s, records retained and globally normalized
comparison_limit: Within-sweep offered-load point. Only quality-gated runs may be compared as gateway capacity evidence.
